headline: Brewed in gold.
body: Hand-plucked at dawn, 2,000 metres up in the Himalayan foothills.

headline: Two leaves and a bud.
body: Plucked by hand in the morning mist, then withered and rolled within hours so the spring flavour stays bright.

headline: Into the glass.
body: Whole leaf, never dust. Each leaf drifts down through crystal-clear walls, waiting quietly to awaken.

headline: The water stirs.
body: Water just off the boil wakes the leaf. Steam rises, carrying spring blossom and the first hint of muscatel.

headline: A colour of gold.
body: Clarity turns to warmth. Within three minutes the cup glows a bright, golden amber.

headline: Poured, slowly.
body: Light, floral and naturally sweet — a cup that rewards patience.

headline: Your moment of calm.
body: Single-estate Darjeeling, freshly packed and shipped free over ₹999.
